title: Large monorepo refactor: rename the public token-meter API across every real consumer
objective:
In the copied DeepSeek Harness repository at {{workspace}}, migrate the public method `measure(session, requestHeader?)` of the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` package to `measureContext(...)`, keeping its signature, token measurement and compaction behaviour unchanged. Migrate every real consumer, every test, the model-visible API catalogue and the bilingual documentation. Do not keep an alias for the old name, do not touch unrelated measure methods, and do not rewrite archival history.

Organize the delivery with one child management node that owns the compaction package (`packages/compaction/compaction-basic`) and one that owns the ACP package (`packages/acp/acp`); the root keeps the token-meter package definition (`packages/llm/token-meter`), the generated catalogue and the final integration. The generated files and the three README variants are written serially by the root after the child management nodes have committed their work.

initial_transactions.objective: Own the token-meter package definition (`packages/llm/token-meter`), the generated catalogue and the final integration of the `measure` → `measureContext` migration in {{workspace}}. Delegate the compaction package to one child management node and the ACP package to another.
initial_transactions.expected_output: A repository where the public token-meter API is named `measureContext`, every real consumer and test uses it, the generated catalogue and bilingual documentation are regenerated, and the old name exists nowhere in source.
acceptance_criteria: No production file calls `.measure(` on a token-meter instance
The eight named vitest specs run with no new failures relative to the pre-change baseline
`pnpm exec tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` and `pnpm exec tsc -b tsconfig.client.json` exit 0
The generated catalogue and the three README variants are regenerated by their own generators
